trajectory_projected.save_error: Could not save. Use Retry save to try again.
trajectory_projected.reset.title: Restore default settings?
trajectory_projected.reset.description: This resets every Trajectory Projected setting. Your current settings will be replaced.
trajectory_projected.hint.toggle: Click or press Enter to toggle. Hover for details.
trajectory_projected.hint.number: Drag the value left/right. Hold Shift for finer adjustment. Keyboard: left/right arrows.
trajectory_projected.setting.enabled.des: Shows where the arrow will fly while you draw a bow. A key to switch it can be set in Controls.
trajectory_projected.setting.first_perso: In first person the line starts beside the view and bends into the path, so it does not collapse under the crosshair.
trajectory_projected.setting.dot_size.de: Size of the dots and the hit marker.
trajectory_projected.setting.far_dimming: The line fades a little beyond about 50 blocks.
trajectory_projected.setting.show_hidden: Parts of the path behind blocks are drawn faint and outlined.
trajectory_projected.setting.spread_zone: Where the server's random spread can put the arrow, shown as a shade on the blocks around the hit. The options below choose what it shows.
trajectory_projected.setting.zone_full.d: The zone reaches the edge no shot crosses. Off, it ends at the widest ring that is on.
trajectory_projected.setting.zone_half_r: Ring for half of the shots
About half of the shots land inside this ring.
trajectory_projected.setting.zone_wide_r: About 90%% of the shots land inside this ring.
trajectory_projected.setting.zone_tick_c: On a server, a partial draw can count a tick more or less than here. The zone then covers that too: more accurate, but larger and busier. No effect in singleplayer or at full draw.
A larger dot where the arrow will land.
trajectory_projected.setting.living_puls: The line pulses when the arrow will hit a mob or a player.
trajectory_projected.setting.living_cros: The hit marker becomes a cross when the arrow will hit a mob or a player.
trajectory_projected.setting.crosshair_t: The crosshair turns into a cross when the arrow will hit a mob or a player.
trajectory_projected.unavailable.hit_mar: Turn on the hit marker to use this.
trajectory_projected.unavailable.spread_: Turn on the spread zone to use this.
